title.zh: Suphx 图 13：保留安全牌的局部案例
title.en: Suphx Figure 13: keeping a safe tile

documentedFacts.zh: 论文图 13 展示状态 st，并以红框标出当时可安全打出的北风。
documentedFacts.en: Figure 13 shows state st and marks the North tile as safe to discard at that state.

documentedFacts.zh: 论文称多数人类牌手会打出红框北风，但 Suphx 实际打出蓝框七索并保留北风。
documentedFacts.en: The paper says most human players would discard the red-boxed North tile, while Suphx discards the blue-boxed seven of bamboo and keeps North.

documentedFacts.zh: 论文用一个假设性后续状态解释：若其他玩家意外立直，保留的北风可作为安全牌，而不必拆散接近和牌的面子或对子。
documentedFacts.en: The paper explains with a hypothetical later state: if another player unexpectedly declares Riichi, the retained North tile can be discarded safely without breaking a meld or pair close to a winning hand.

limits.zh: 论文只披露这一决策状态及其策略解释，没有给出完整牌谱、后续真实动作或最终胜负。
limits.en: The paper discloses this decision state and its strategic explanation, not a complete log, subsequent real actions, or the final outcome.

body.zh: 只重绘论文图 13 披露的单一状态，不补造完整牌局。
body.en: Only the single state disclosed in Figure 13 is redrawn; no full game is reconstructed.

body.zh: 红框北风当下安全；蓝框七索是 Suphx 实际选择。
body.en: The red-boxed North is currently safe; the blue-boxed seven of bamboo is Suphx's actual choice.

body.zh: 打出七索可能减慢成牌，却为未来防守保留北风。
body.en: Discarding seven of bamboo may slow the hand, but preserves North for future defense.

body.zh: 蓝框七索进入牌河；北风仍留在手中。
body.en: The blue-boxed seven of bamboo enters the discard pool; North remains in hand.

body.zh: 若对手随后意外立直，Suphx 仍可打出保留的安全北风。
body.en: If an opponent unexpectedly declares Riichi later, Suphx can still discard the retained safe North.

body.zh: 这个局部案例说明 Suphx 会用短期进攻速度换取未来攻防弹性；它不是完整牌局回放。
body.en: This partial case shows Suphx trading short-term attack speed for future flexibility; it is not a complete-game replay.
